Delhi Court Denies Bail in Riots Case, Cites Chats

A Delhi court has denied bail to Athar Khan in connection with the larger conspiracy case related to the Delhi riots. The court reportedly considered chats from February 17th discussing a road blockade and inciting violence. This decision comes amidst differing narratives surrounding the cause and timing of the riots.
